title.narrative: Strengthening health services for Syrian refugees and the host community in Lebanon, Arsal Governorate - Baalbek

description.narrative: Providing integrated health care free of charge according to correct standards and improving it / developing the national system for health information and data management / supporting existing national programs such as tuberculosis and HIV / STI related to infectious diseases and quickly monitoring and referring them to the competent authority / participating in routine vaccination campaigns approved by the World Health Organization and the Ministry of Health Lebanese / health and nutrition awareness and education, promotion of personal and general hygiene, limiting the spread of epidemic, infectious and communicable diseases, promotion of healthy nutrition methods, measuring children’s weight and height, the need to deal with cases of dwarfism and cases that need nutritional support / psychological support for refugees and the host community in general, and children with disabilities movement and sensory especially, and help them reach specialized centers to obtain the necessary medical needs / provide health care services and psychological, social and nutritional support and participate in routine vaccination campaigns and provide free medicines to Syrian refugees in the Arsal region and its countryside and Lebanese citizens in the Republic of Lebanon for free

Supporting a primary health care center in the Baalbek-Arsal region, providing health services in accordance with the standards of the World Health Organization and the Lebanese Ministry of Health, linking the health services provided with an information and technical health system that ensures sustainable follow-up, and strengthening the medical referral system and the administrative system that ensures the desired medical goals.

The center's readiness to provide health and nutritional care, psychological and social health services, and diagnostic services/ securing job opportunities for licensed Lebanese and Syrian medical and professional cadres/ limiting the migration of medical and professional cadres/ providing health and nutritional services, psychological support, educating them from specialized cadres, alleviating the suffering of Syrian refugees in Lebanon, and providing Services for (110,000) beneficiaries.
